generations.prompt: An old woman in a mustard cardigan sits alone in a wooden armchair on a timber porch in the soft light of early evening, hands folded in her lap, looking out at a field of tall grass. She is calm and still and a little far away; she breathes, blinks, and her eyes move slowly across the field. Her lips stay closed; she does not speak. Her loose silver hair stays down on her shoulders. A small cloth-covered device sits dark and switched off on the table beside her. The grass moves in a light wind. Nobody else is present. Sound: wind in tall grass, evening insects, a porch board ticking. Nobody speaks. The camera is locked off and does not move. No music. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text of any kind.
